title: Right mate for a single finite rational coefficient extension
statement: Fix a prime l, two finite extensions E and F of Q_l and a Q_l-algebra inclusion iota:E to F [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let f:X to Y be any morphism of schemes with l invertible in every residue field. On the recorded raw rational constructible categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], let R_E and R_F be supplied right adjoints to the rational derived pullbacks L_E and L_F of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], with specified adjunctions aE and aF. The literal Mathlib right mate under aE and aF of the inverse normalized rationalPullbackScalarComparison(l,E,F,iota,f) is an isomorphism. The scalar functors are exactly sfRationalScalarExtension with p=0 and the canonical prime nonzero proof. No algebraic closure, directed coefficient index, stage system, coherence family, uniqueness assertion, or existence of right adjoints is involved.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2; Proposition 6.8.14(2); Remark 6.8.15; finite-free coefficient argument in the parent coefficient-compatibility proof

proof.text: For the single finite extension, write T_W for the recorded rational scalar extension and U_W for restriction of coefficients, W=X,Y. Finite freeness of O_F over O_E identifies ordinary completed extension with the normalized completed scalar construction. Restriction is exact and preserves derived completeness and constructibility; finite generation is preserved because O_F is finite over O_E. Rationalize these restrictions. The trace pairing of the finite characteristic-zero extension F/E is nondegenerate: choose an E-basis b_i and its trace-dual basis c_i, with Tr(b_i c_j)=delta_ij. The maps m to sum_i b_i tensor c_i m and z tensor m to Tr(z)m give U_W left adjoint to T_W. A common nonzero denominator makes these formulas integral, so they define maps in raw rationalization independently of the denominator. The two dual-basis identities prove both triangles. Ramification causes denominators, which are inverted; it does not require a perfect integral trace pairing.

Transpose the inverse normalized scalar/pullback comparison along U_Y left adjoint to T_Y and U_X left adjoint to T_X. It is the natural restriction/pullback comparison U_X L_F versus L_E U_Y, with the directions fixed by mateEquiv. On simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives, ordinary scalar tensor balancing and the dual-basis formulas identify its components with forgetting the coefficient action before versus after pullback. Finite free restriction preserves flat K-flat representatives and commutes with the reduction towers and limits that define completed pullback. Therefore this precise transpose is invertible. The completed scalar comparison and the component specification of rationalPullbackScalarComparison ensure the map is the recorded normalized one, not an arbitrary endpoint isomorphism.

Apply Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv to the supplied pullback/right-adjoint adjunctions and the coefficient adjunctions of step 1. It identifies the further transpose of the prescribed right mate with conjugation of the invertible restriction/pullback transpose from step 2, between composite adjunctions. conjugateEquiv_of_iso reflects invertibility. Thus the prescribed right mate is invertible. Only the supplied adjunctions are used, with no assertion that ambient geometric direct image preserves the full constructible category for arbitrary f. Identity extensions reduce to the scalar unit; the same formulas apply to zero complexes and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalPullbackScalar_rightMate_isIso
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E F : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [Field F] [Algebra ℚ_[l] F] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (RE : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X ⥤ sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (RF : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F X ⥤ sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F Y)
    (aE : rationalDerivedPullback l E f ⊣ RE)
    (aF : rationalDerivedPullback l F f ⊣ RF) :
    IsIso ((mateEquiv aE aF
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E F ι f).inv)).natTrans)
